name: Switch
description: Toggles a setting that takes effect immediately.

checked.description: Whether the switch is in the on state

onCheckedChange.description: Called with the next state when the user toggles the switch

label.description: Visible label beside the track (outside the switch element, tied by aria-labelledby)

helperText.description: Helper text shown below the label (preferred)

readOnly.description: The switch cannot be toggled; an off track takes the band and a dashed edge

required.description: The switch must be on before the form submits

invalid.description: The value fails validation: errorMessage shows under the label with an icon

errorMessage.description: Message shown with a warning icon under the label while invalid; wired to aria-describedby

className.description: Class on the outer element: the label row, or the track when there is no visible text

when: Settings that apply the moment they change
Turning a feature on or off in a settings panel
The result is visible straight away
whenNot: Choices that only apply on submit (use Checkbox)
Several options at once (use a Checkbox group)
Yes/no questions in a form (use RadioGroup)
More than two states (use Select or RadioGroup)
guidelines: The label names what is being turned on
On always means enabled, never the reverse
Apply the change immediately — no save button
Add helperText when the label alone is ambiguous
accessibility: Every switch has a label, visible or aria-label

examples.name: Default Off
examples.description: Nothing happens until the user flips it.

examples.name: Checked
examples.description: Starts on; the track fills with the accent colour.

examples.name: With Helper Text
examples.description: Second line says what the setting actually does.
examples.code:
<StatefulSwitch
  defaultChecked
  label="Auto-save"
  helperText="Automatically save changes as you type"
/>

args.label: Auto-save
args.helperText: Automatically save changes as you type

examples.name: Disabled and Read-only
examples.description: Disabled dims once; read-only keeps full ink and refuses the toggle.

examples.name: Settings Panel
examples.description: Stacked switches sharing one rhythm and helper column.

examples.name: Invalid
examples.description: A message with an icon under the label; the track keeps its colours.
examples.code:
<StatefulSwitch
  label="Share findings with the team"
  invalid
  errorMessage="Sharing is off on this plan."
/>

relations.note: Input handles text/number entry; Switch handles boolean state
Use Checkbox when change requires form submission

propsSummary: label: string - visible label beside the track
helperText: string - helper text below label
disabled: boolean - non-interactive state, dims once
errorMessage: node - message with an icon under the label while invalid
